objective: Make the scope inference enforce that only the user's own uncommitted .claude/settings.local.json moves bare setup and doctor to local scope; today a repository that commits that file selects local scope and a pi install -l with its own .npmrc.
scope: Worktree /home/user/holyagent-0.3.0-scope, branch release/0.3.0/feat/installed-scope-default, head 1991d0c (committed; your edits are a new change on top).

Blocking finding from code and security review: installedScope and enablement (packages/runtime/src/setup/scope.ts:163-189) never check that the local file is untracked. A cloned repository that commits .claude/settings.local.json with holyagent@holyagent enabled makes a bare setup run at local scope, which then runs pi install -l in the repository (packages/runtime/src/setup/pi-install.ts:87,125-134) with the repository's .npmrc and .holyagent/config.json. Infer local only when the folder is a git work tree that claudeFolder judges trusted (scope.ts:76-82 already computes this) and git reports the local file untracked (not in the index, for example git ls-files --error-unmatch fails for it). A tracked local file, an untrusted folder, or a folder that is not a git work tree (a source archive) leaves the scope at user, with a line naming the file and why, as the committed project file already does. Use the Bun Shell as the rest of setup does.

Tests: tracked settings.local.json gives user plus the line; untracked enabled gives local; no .git gives user; the existing cases still hold. Update the code comment near scope.ts:171 and docs/usage.md (lines 39, 57, 67 and 131) and docs/pi/installation.md (line 44) so they say exactly this rule.
Ride-along: docs/usage.md should tell a user to pass --scope on a repeated setup --undo, because a first undo can remove the entry that made local inferable.

Make no git writes (no commit, add, checkout, stash, branch) and no edits under .git/ or .holyagent/; the root commits. Report your changed paths.

Follow the repository rules in .claude/CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md of the worktree: Effect for effects and errors with tagged errors (no try/catch, new Promise, Promise statics or async functions in runtime and CLI source), Effect Schema at data boundaries with onExcessProperty error, Bun APIs and the Bun Shell, JSDoc on every exported function and type.
Testing is unit tests and recorded or synthesized fixtures only: never start pi, a Pi session, T3 Code or a Kimi request.

Gates, run in your worktree: `bunx --no-install mise run build` (commit-ready generated output; the tree must have no unexplained changes after it) and `bunx --no-install mise run verify` (type-check, lint, format check, tests) must exit 0. Give the command, exit code and test counts.

Write `git diff` of your change (after the build) to a file outside the repository in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-holyagent/43946df6-456d-58c6-bea3-7e958fcb9495/scratchpad and give its path as diff-file evidence.
Build only what the Assignment asks; name any further improvement in the report instead of adding it.
Report in under 400 words; put long logs in a file in the scratchpad above and give its path.

The generated packages/integrations/claude/dist and packages/integrations/pi/dist are rewritten by mise run build; include those regenerated files in your changed paths, though they are not listed in your ownership paths.

A folder that is not a trusted git work tree never infers local, with a test
An untracked enabled local file still infers local for both the Claude Code and the Pi steps, with a test
